transformation_steps: Download only the identified image file from the public CSIRO file endpoint.
Verify the exact byte count and SHA-256 before accepting the input.
Decode as RGB and downscale to fit within 900 by 600 pixels for display; no scientific values are extracted from the RGB pixels.
Combine with the already committed reviewed mask, surface arrays, and error map to render the existing Figure 3 panels.
